Logwin AG Announces Major Expansion of Luxembourg Operations

Logwin AG, a leading provider in the transportation and logistics sector, has announced a significant expansion of its operations in Luxembourg, reaffirming its long-term commitment to the region’s logistics industry. The expansion will see the addition of a new 20,000-square-meter distribution facility in the Bettembourg-Dudelange logistics park, increasing Logwin AG's local warehousing and cross-docking capacity by nearly 30 percent.

“At Logwin AG, we are dedicated to supporting the growing needs of our customers in Luxembourg and across Europe,” said Marc Stein, Managing Director of Logwin AG Luxembourg. “This expansion will allow us to offer faster, more flexible logistics solutions and create up to 50 new jobs in the area over the next two years.”

Industry analysts say the move reflects Luxembourg’s strategic role as a logistics hub within the European Union, citing its central location and advanced infrastructure. “Luxembourg continues to attract investment from major logistics providers due to its connectivity and business-friendly environment,” noted Sophie Weber, senior analyst at the European Logistics Federation.

The new facility, which is set to be operational by early 2025, will feature sustainable design elements including energy-efficient lighting and solar panels. Local officials have welcomed the investment, highlighting the economic benefits for the region. “Logwin AG’s expansion is a positive signal for our local workforce and supply chain ecosystem,” commented Jean-Paul Muller, President of the Luxembourg Logistics Association.

The company is partnering with the construction firm EuroBuild S.A. for the development of the site. Logwin AG has indicated that further technology upgrades within its Luxembourg operations are under review, as the company continues to adapt to evolving customer requirements and market demands.
